name: Obby or Die!
desc:
😁 Hey, welcome to Obby But Gets Harder

😡 This game gets increasingly more difficult as you play and progress through it!

🤔 Are you one of the few who can beat this obby... or will you be like the rest, falling into the void and dying?

- 223 stages 📊
- Saves progress 📂
- Really fun 😉
- Ranks to grind 🎉

🎉 Have fun!

💖 Made with love by @EmilioEnito and @DistortedPhysics
